notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist in graveyard with a sticker on it.
Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Sacrifice four Treasure tokens to add {3}{B}.
Sacrifice Dockside Extortionist to Goblin Bombardment, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
